scope: Unchanged selected original Godot application PNG bytes. No cropping, resizing, retouching, overlays, synthetic imagery or post-production. Complete99-profile/74-supplemental/40-motion corpus remains in original artifact; this is a small reviewable selection. Camera window_size is recorded logical/requested state; actual_image_extent is decoded from the original PNG.

optics_statistics.actor_reveal_source: Published visual bounds only; up to eight actors plus the sampled player.
optics_statistics.alpha_contract: Frozen SubViewport premultiplied RGBA; bounded premultiplied filtering/interpolation; one final straight-alpha conversion and blend. Classic wipe uses the literal legacy straight-alpha expression; full Classic retains its original material.
optics_statistics.aperture_kernel: Dense positive binomial cross; continuous weights; Low <=5, Balanced <=13, High <=25 surface reads.
